title: The achromatic number of Paley graphs, Peisert graphs, and related Cayley graphs
summary: The achromatic number of a graph $G$, denoted $χ_a (G)$, is the maximum number of colors in a proper vertex coloring of $G$. Generalizing a result of Maistrelli and Penman, we prove that for sufficiently large $q$, the achromatic number of the $k$-th power Paley graph is at least $\frac{q-1}{k} + 1$. This lower bound gives the correct order of magnitude in $q$, but determining the correct dependence on $k$ remains open for all $k \geq 3$.
